topics.title: Conduction of heat; good and poor conductors

concepts.learning_objective: Explain conduction as heat passing from particle to neighbouring particle, from the hotter to the colder part of an object, without the particles moving.
Classify materials as good or poor conductors (insulators) of heat and relate this to their everyday uses.

topics.title: Trapped air as an insulator in clothing and houses

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how air trapped in wool, between layers of clothing or between blankets reduces heat flow because air is a poor conductor.
Explain how hollow bricks and walls of wood and mud keep houses comfortable in very hot or cold climates.

topics.title: Convection in air and in liquids

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that heated air expands, becomes lighter and rises, as seen with the paper cups, smoke and a balloon in the Sun.
Describe convection currents in heated water as hot water rising and cooler water sinking to take its place.
Compare how quickly soil and water heat up and cool down in sunlight and in shade.
Explain the formation of sea breeze by day and land breeze by night in coastal areas.

topics.title: Radiation and the three processes together

concepts.learning_objective: State that radiation transfers heat without a material medium, as from the Sun or a fire, and that all objects radiate heat.
Explain why light-coloured clothes suit summer and dark-coloured clothes suit winter.
Identify conduction, convection and radiation acting together in heating water in a pan or using a bukhari.
Describe evaporation, transpiration, condensation and precipitation as steps of the water cycle driven by the Sun's heat.
Explain how the water cycle redistributes and replenishes water while conserving its total amount on the Earth.

topics.title: Seepage of water, groundwater and its conservation

concepts.learning_objective: Relate the rate of infiltration through clay, sand and gravel to the size and connection of the spaces between particles.
Define groundwater and aquifers and explain how water is drawn from them through wells.
Explain causes of groundwater depletion and ways to conserve water such as rainwater harvesting, recharge pits and ice stupas.
